propositions: The original batch-eval-gated strategy for R1-R7 was retired and replaced with an advisory-first + standing-dogfood approach (operator-approved cost decision) to minimize LLM spend and human-adjudication time.

E1 outcome corpus (628 rows, event-mined) was frozen and committed; its finding-adjudication corpus and inter-rater kappa gate were descoped due to ~79% contamination from tool-less/plan-truncated labeling.

E2/E3 expensive LLM batch baselines were permanently rejected on cost and superseded by story d8a5's zero-LLM standing effectiveness recorder (criterion_effectiveness.py); batch mining was independently confirmed infeasible (~4 plan-v3 baselines vs ~200 assumed).

R1/R3/R4 now ship in advisory posture (never block), pass bounded ≤~8-run sanity checks, and are auto-monitored by d8a5 with the advisory→blocking promotion gate documented; advisory-safety + standing dogfood replaces pre-ship batch evals.

R2 (DET floor lint check) does not touch criteria_routing.json (file impact: det_floor.py, workflow_ops.py); R3/R4/R5 serialize on criteria_routing.json/review_kernel to avoid file conflicts with the floor-split story.

All 13 children (E1/E2/E3/E5/E6, R1–R7, d8a5) closed; no detection-bearing recommendation implemented without eval gating or advisory-safety + monitoring equivalent; docs/plan-review-gate.md updated to reflect all changes.
